title: 从提示到协议：用于实验室自动化的AI智能体
summary: 提出一种集成大语言模型与实验室编排的AI智能体架构，使科学家能用自然语言交互式创建和监控自动化实验协议。在实验编排系统（EOS）中实现，支持协议创建、运行、闭环优化及结果分析，并配有可视化图形编辑器。在化学、生物学和材料科学三个模拟实验室中评估，首次协议生成成功率达97%，所需界面操作减少一个数量级。
summary_en: Presents an AI agent architecture integrating LLMs with lab orchestration, enabling scientists to create and monitor automated protocols via natural language. Integrated into EOS, it supports the full experimental lifecycle with visual graph editing. Evaluated on three simulated labs, achieving 97% first-attempt protocol success and an order-of-magnitude reduction in interface actions.
